svg.title: Compare Retained Fees, Not Financed Principal
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-04-specialty-placement-fee-yields; chart type: horizontal_bars; title: Compare Retained Fees, Not Financed Principal; subtitle: Illustrative retained USD per $1,000,000 funded placement.; chapter number: 2; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Each bar uses an identical illustrative $1,000,000 financed amount. Values are retained brokerage fees, not lender yields or quoted market rates. Eight placements in each of five categories produce 40 closings, $40,000,000 underlying principal, and $560,000 operator revenue. Fees require transaction-specific permissibility, agreement, disclosure, and retention.; caption: Eight times ($15,000 + $10,000 + $10,000 + $20,000 + $15,000) equals $560,000. The equal-weight average is $14,000 retained fees per funded placement.; stages: label: Equipment acquisition debt; value: $15,000 retained | 1.50%; numeric value: 15000.0; detail: Model eight placements producing $120,000 retained fees. Verify equipment invoices, asset identification, useful life, advance rate, and lien position before sending the collateral package to lenders.; label: Receivables-backed facilities; value: $10,000 retained | 1.00%; numeric value: 10000.0; detail: Model eight placements producing $80,000 retained fees. Review dilution, debtor concentration, eligibility exclusions, and borrowing-base reporting; model no recurring residual compensation unless contractually earned.; label: SBA-backed business loans; value: $10,000 retained | 1.00%; numeric value: 10000.0; detail: Model eight placements producing $80,000 retained fees. This percentage is an arithmetic assumption, not an authorized tariff; apply 13 CFR 103.5, current program requirements, and Form 159 where required.; label: Commercial bridge debt; value: $20,000 retained | 2.00%; numeric value: 20000.0; detail: Model eight placements producing $160,000 retained fees. Verify repayment exit, maturity, collateral valuation, and extension terms; resolve real-estate broker licensing requirements when collateral triggers them.; label: Purchase-order working capital; value: $15,000 retained | 1.50%; numeric value: 15000.0; detail: Model eight placements producing $120,000 retained fees. Confirm purchase-order authenticity, supplier performance, customer acceptance conditions, and control of proceeds before selecting an appropriate funding structure.

circle.title: label: Equipment acquisition debt; value: $15,000 retained | 1.50%; numeric value: 15000.0; detail: Model eight placements producing $120,000 retained fees. Verify equipment invoices, asset identification, useful life, advance rate, and lien position before sending the collateral package to lenders.

label: Receivables-backed facilities; value: $10,000 retained | 1.00%; numeric value: 10000.0; detail: Model eight placements producing $80,000 retained fees. Review dilution, debtor concentration, eligibility exclusions, and borrowing-base reporting; model no recurring residual compensation unless contractually earned.

Confirm purchase-order authenticity, supplier performance, customer acceptance conditions, and control of proceeds before selecting an appropriate funding structure.

text.title: Assumptions: Each bar uses an identical illustrative $1,000,000 financed amount. Values are retained brokerage fees, not lender yields or quoted market rates. Eight placements in each of five categories produce 40 closings, $40,000,000 underlying principal, and $560,000 operator revenue. Fees require transaction-specific permissibility, agreement, disclosure, and retention.
